parityGateReview.status: complete (agent review of the visual parity gate; not a production approval)

exceptions.reason: live content is a third-party iframe blocked by the measurement network; not bypassed

sourceProject.name: Wonderful marketing site clone
sourceProject.stack: React 18 + react-router-dom 6 (BrowserRouter) + Vite 5 + Tailwind 3 (documentation only: no contract, token or section id depends on it)
sourceProject.note: The source project is a git repository (this clone). design-repo.zip is a build artifact: it stays out of design-repo/ and out of version control (.gitignore lists it; verify_all.py checks that no archive is tracked). declaredRanges are re-diffed against package.json by verify_all.py when the source tree is present.

visibility: PRIVATE. Do not publish: this repo describes a real, live company (Wonderful AI B.V.) and cites its real customers, employees, quotes, logos, press outlets and form endpoints (see assets/asset-roles.json licensing and schema/source-brand.json).
categoryDecision: SaaS (enterprise B2B platform), moderate confidence: multi-tenant SaaS / single-tenant / BYOC delivery, consumption-based pricing and an MSA + SLA legal stack, but no pricing, sign-up or log-in surface and a sales-only conversion path. Evidence and counter-evidence with file:line are in policy/design-policy.json; the classification is an agent decision (agent attestation, not a human sign-off) pending architecture review.

modes.reference: faithful reconstruction of the Wonderful clone; real brand, copy and assets are allowed as evidence (schema/example.pagespec.json and schema/examples/reference-*.json are the controls)
modes.generated: a new page for another brand; schema/semantic_validate.py rejects all Wonderful identity, copy, claims, people, customers, URLs, store marks and reference-only / blocked asset roles (GENERATED_MODE_* rules; schema/examples/generated-*.json are the controls)

designPolicy.contentHashScope: sha256 over the files in policy/design-policy.json enforcedBy (recomputed by verify_all.py); not over the common policy document, which is not shipped here

irPolicy: No IR is generated, edited or removed by this repository's tooling (standing user instruction); see CHANGELOG 'IR left untouched by request'.
